scope: Static checkpoints use the SAME visual-agent controller to isolate task setting. These are not one-shot static model answers.

definitions.success: Explicit finish and physically equivalent target, with final constraints.
definitions.F1: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), physical part type/color/pose equivalence. Fixed context excluded.
definitions.qualifiedRecovery: Successful matched normal prerequisite; completed or model-budget-exhausted incident episode, all scheduled effective events applied.
definitions.legalActionRate: Accepted physical moves / well-formed physical attempts, per evaluator. Not an episode success rate.
definitions.falseRepair: At least one accepted move on an initially correct S0 scene; extra observations alone do not count.
definitions.errorReduction: 1 - final edit residual / initial residual; N/A when initial residual is zero. Can be negative.
definitions.referenceMoves: One legal reference path, not a proven shortest path. Alternative orders are accepted.
